$comment: Endpoints in crates/xdk/vendor/x-api-openapi.json that xr deliberately leaves without a shortcut command. An operation is "METHOD /path"; METHOD may be *, and a path ending in /** also covers every path below it. A decision holds until its revisit_when fires: never, github-pr-merged (repo, number), or crate-published (crate). crates/xdk/tests/endpoint_decisions.rs holds every entry to the spec and the shortcut list; scripts/endpoint-decisions.sh marks covered operations in a spec-refresh PR and reports fired triggers daily.

decisions.reason: XChat conversations are end-to-end encrypted: sending and reading them needs the conversation keys and message signatures that X's chat-xdk-core library handles, and that library is unpublished. Raw mode still reaches the endpoints.

Joining a call hands out a single-use, two-minute token for a real-time PCM16 audio WebSocket that xr does not drive, and starting one makes an empty call that xr calls scheduled add already provides. X marks the Calls API as in development. Raw mode still reaches the endpoints.
No xr activity family: raw mode covers the subscription endpoints and streams /2/activity/stream like every stream the spec declares.
